sections.title: O-Ring Free Torus
sections.text: id is the positive inner diameter and cs the positive cross-section diameter with cs < id. The recipe creates a cross-section circle on the section plane (default auto-picked to contain the axis, XZ for the default Z axis) at mean radius (id+cs)/2 and revolves it 360 deg about the axis (default Z). A plane perpendicular to the revolve axis is rejected as a degenerate revolve. The mean radius is an initial expression and the cross-section radius a driving sketch dimension (recipeRegeneration).

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, feature, bodies, healthState, message, helpers, recipe:o-ring, atomic:false, free:true, torus:true, innerDiameter, cs, meanRadius, crossRadius, crossArea, volume, volumeFormula, dependencies, regeneration, affected}. Lengths are mm, volume mm^3. volume = 2*pi^2*R*r^2 with R=(id+cs)/2 and r=cs/2. Geometry is a free torus; an installed O-ring is a different deformed body.

examples.label: 10 mm ID x 2 mm CS O-ring
examples.requires: Native component; ORing and ORing__section names unused.

verified: Cross-section radius is a driving dimension
bugs: Installed/compressed O-ring deformation is a separate body, not modeled here

sections.title: Gland Groove
sections.text: type is radial, face or dynamic. oRing has id and cs. Supply gland.depth or a target squeeze fraction (exclusive). swell is a volume-swell fraction scaling the installed cross-section by sqrt(1+swell); stretch is an installed stretch ratio. squeeze = (installedCs - depth)/installedCs; fill = o-ring cross-area / groove area. tolerance is {depth:{minus,plus},width:{minus,plus}}. hardStop {clearance} limits gland compression at a metallic contact. Bounds squeezeMin/squeezeMax/fillMin/fillMax default to conventional targets but are declared, not certified.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, type, oRing{id,cs,volume}, installedCs, stretch, swell, gland{depth,width}, squeeze{nominal,range}, fill{nominal,range}, hardStop, installedEnvelope, dynamicNote, checks}. status is fail when the computed squeeze or fill range leaves the declared bounds. installedEnvelope states the geometry is not a material/sealing solution.

examples.label: Radial piston gland at 15% squeeze
examples.output: result.gland.depth is about installedCs*(1-0.15); result.squeeze.nominal is about 0.15 and result.checks report pass.

verified: Squeeze/fill ranges from declared dimensions and tolerances
Hard stop limits compression, does not set squeeze

sections.title: Gasket / Poppet Profile
sections.text: crossSection is {shape:circle,radius} or {shape:custom,points:[[x,y],...]} where custom points must close (first == last). layout is gasket (closed sweep path), face or poppet (revolution). A custom (non-circular) cross-section is explicitly not a plain O-ring: P060 is a shaped gasket profile and is never silently reclassified.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, crossSection{shape,isPlainORing,radius,continuity}, layout, envelope, note}. continuity reports geometric closure only. envelope is a sweep (gasket) or revolution (face/poppet). The note states an installed envelope is geometric and never fakes a material solution.

examples.label: Closed gasket profile
examples.output: result.crossSection.isPlainORing is false and continuity.closed is true.

verified: Custom cross-section is not reclassified as an O-ring
Gasket path vs face/poppet revolution envelope

sections.title: Installed Seal Evaluation
sections.text: Evaluates an installed seal: oRing {id,cs} against an installed gland {depth,width}. squeeze = (installedCs - depth)/installedCs; fill = cross-area / groove area; gland volume compared to the seal cross-area. gap and extrusionGapLimit are optional: without pressure and material hardness the gap limit is reported notEvaluated, never derived from diameter. hardStop {clearance} checks the metallic contact.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, type, squeeze, fill, sealCrossArea, glandCrossArea, oRingVolume, installedCs, installedEnvelope, checks[]}. status is fail when a declared check fails (squeeze outside (0,1), seal area exceeds groove, gap over limit, negative hard-stop clearance); missing limits are notEvaluated.

examples.label: Installed 10x2 seal in a 1.6x2.4 groove
examples.output: result.squeeze is about (2-1.6)/2 = 0.2 and result.checks report pass.

verified: Extrusion gap limit reported unknown without pressure and hardness

sections.title: Dock Sequence
sections.text: connect is an ordered [{event,at}] array that must include a seal-contact event and at least one valve-open event, and must be monotonic in axial position. disconnect defaults to the reversed connect. float, axialTolerance and locatorTolerance reduce the worst-case seal-before-open margin. minimumSealBeforeOpen defaults to 0.5 mm. The check requires the seal to contact before any valve opens.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, connectOrder, disconnectOrder, sealContact, valveOpen, sealBeforeOpenMargin, worstCaseMargin, float, axialTolerance, locatorTolerance, requiredMargin, checks[]}. checks include seal-before-open (pass when worstCaseMargin >= requiredMargin), both-valve-open and seal-after-close. status is fail when the seal-before-open margin is below the requirement.

examples.label: Seal before both valves open
examples.output: result.sealBeforeOpenMargin is 0.6 mm and worstCaseMargin 0.5 mm, so seal-before-open passes.
